ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 rider no-show cancellation fee (driver share $4.50); no refund or account flag — close the case and notify the rider.
ruling.reasoning: The cancellation came from the driver [F4], so the fee can only stand through NS-0's driver-branch, i.e. NS-1/NS-2 [RD-2 not engaged]. NS-1 is conjunctive: (i) an arrival confirmation, (ii) at the pickup at that moment, (iii) a continuous wait of more than 3 minutes thereafter. The arrival confirmation was a driver tap ("I'm Here") at 18:24:35, 41 m from the pickup [F6], inside the 200 m data-layer radius, so (i) and (ii) are met [F6][F1][NS-1]. For (iii), the record measures 230 s (3 min 50 s) continuously inside the radius after the tap, up to the cancellation at 18:28:25 [F6][F4], against the >180 s threshold; the GPS trace covers the wait with no hole and shows the car stationary at 41 m from 18:24:15 to the cancellation [F2][F3][F6], so the wait is established by record and not inferred between samples [NS-1]. All three elements hold and the $6.61 fee on record [F7] stands; NS-2 (full refund) is therefore not triggered [F4][F7][NS-1][NS-2].

rejected_claims.reason: Misreads the post-tap wait: 18:24:35 to 18:28:25 is 3 min 50 s (230 s), which exceeds the >180 s requirement of NS-1(iii), as measured in F6 with cancellation at F4; NS-2's full refund is therefore not triggered [F6][F4][NS-1][NS-2].

The pre-tap period is irrelevant to NS-1(iii), which counts only time after the arrival confirmation; F6 supplies 3 min 50 s after the tap and F3 shows continuous stationary presence at 41 m through the cancellation [F3][F5][F6][NS-1].

The rider's message asking for two more minutes [F10] is a courtesy request, not consent to a route or fee change relevant here, and no clause makes it binding; the driver outlasted it, cancelling 3 min 25 s after it and 3 min 50 s after his tap [F10][F4][F6][NS-1].
The finding does not rest on the cumulative 5 min 15 s in F2; the qualifying period is the post-tap 230 s in F6, which alone satisfies NS-1(iii) [F2][F6][NS-1].

Premised on NS-1(iii) failing, which the trace's measured 230 s post-tap wait contradicts, so the fees stand and NS-2's refund does not arise; NS-7's voucher form and 30-day window only apply to a refund that is owed [F4][F6][F7][NS-1][NS-2][NS-7].

Profile facts cannot decide a case and only support an add-on account action under RD-6 where the case is established against the driver with route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; the driver's two upheld 90-day disputes are recorded as no-show, not route, so RD-6 is not engaged [F18][RD-6].
